convert_hubert_checkpoint: convert a DistilHubert s3prl checkpoint to a PyTorch Hubert model and save to output folder
convert_config: convert a DistilHubert s3prl config to a HuggingFace HubertConfig with matching architecture parameters
recursively_load_weights: load and map s3prl DistilHubert weights into a HuggingFace HubertModel using key mappings
load_conv_layer: load convolutional layer weights from s3prl checkpoint into HuggingFace feature extractor conv layers
set_recursively: set recursively nested model weights with shape validation and type-aware assignment
